To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
undergraduate disabled students as researchers and knowledge-producers is a missed topic in academic literature.
there is a knowledge deficit on the topic of undergraduate disabled students being researchers.
there is a lack of studies investigating the lived experience of undergraduate disabled students in the role as researchers.
In summary, our research is concerned with
undergraduate disabled students as researchers.
the role of disabled students as researchers.
the role of undergraduate students with disabilities in knowledge production.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the coverage of undergraduate students as knowledge producers in the literature is limited and the coverage of undergraduate disability students as knowledge producers is very limited.
the topic of undergraduate disabled students’ role as knowledge producers including researchers is under-researched.
undergraduate disabled students as researchers are a topic that has been largely missed in academic literature.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

undergraduate disabled students are not sufficiently considered as knowledge producers including researchers in the academic literature, despite their potential to increase the knowledge available about disabled people, to increase the number disabled academic faculty and to increase the degree success of undergraduate disabled students in STEM education.
the topic of undergraduate disabled students being knowledge producers, including being researchers, is underexplored and that there is a need for more studies in this field.

the role of undergraduate students as researchers is a topic that is not covered in the literature and that the role of disabled undergraduate students as researchers might be a topic that is even less covered.
The main takeaway from our work is that

there is a lack of research on how undergraduate disabled students can become knowledge producers including researchers and that this lack of research is a problem for the disabled community and the community in general.
there is a knowledge gap on the topic of undergraduate disabled students being knowledge producers including researchers.
undergraduate disabled students as researchers is a topic that is not covered in the academic literature, and as such, it is a missed topic.
